items.title: Unicorn Skyblock
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Play skyblock with your friends in a beautiful dream castle. Ride the unicorn and fly with it and have fun.

+ Unicorn
+ Skyblock
+ Fly
+ Free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Halloween Stories
items.creator: JFCrafters
items.description: Halloween is here, Get ready to tell a scary story. Why not tell it in style with these awesome Halloween themed skins.

items.title: Mythical Halloween
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: The moon is out and full! Be apart of the pack with these terrifying transformation skins!

items.title: Teen Demon School
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Come and have fun with these little devils from the marketplace!

- 12 skins
- 1 Free skin
- By UnderBlocks

items.title: Fall Weddings
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Autumn turns over a new leaf for you and your love. Celebrate a dream wedding with you and your friends as the bride, groom, or bridal party. We even have a ring barking pup! Whether you're just married, soon to be married, wish to be married or just down to crash a party, this pack of 13 skins has the right one for you.

items.title: Escape the Horror House Part 2
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Once again, you have woken up trapped inside Minecraft's most haunted house!

Try to escape and take on 4 brand new custom mobs!

Have you got what it takes to beat this horror home?

Battle your way through tricks, traps, puzzles, parkour and more!

Challenge yourself now with this truly unique Halloween dungeon-crawler!

items.title: Halloween Costume Contest
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Just in time for the scary season! Pick your favorite fashionable Halloween costume and enter yourself in the best looking Halloween Costume Contest with these admirable skins! These outfits will be perfect for Autumn and Fall! 

- 8 epic trendy skins!
- 1 free skin!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Heroes of Magic
items.creator: Cyclone
items.description:
Become a Hero of Magic on a fantastical island! Explore the vampire, angel & demon cities, search for treasure & mystical gemstones and customise your armor & weapons. Werewolves, Witches, enchanted pets & radiant portals await you in Heroes of Magic!

+ 60+ custom armor pieces to mix & match
+ 6 faction cities & 24 dungeons to explore
+ New faction weapons & pets

items.title: Skyblock Dimensions
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Explore four different dimensions, collect lucky blocks, unlock keys, and encounter different boss fights as you explore this world of skyblock! Get to interact with new mobs to fight with and experience a very unique way of playing skyblock!

+ Tons of sky islands!
+ Three challenging boss fights!
+ New RUBY ingot to find and craft!

items.title: WEAPONS+
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Craft yourself a variety of weapons here in WEAPONS+! Collect rubies to create your own ruby sword, use purpur to make a new shield, slice mobs with your own obsidian sword, or cast spells with your own redstone staff! Everything is possible here!

+ 60+ new weapons!
+ Unique effects every weapon!
+ Be a wizard with spells!
+ New shields added!
+ PvP & PvE!

items.title: CUTE ICONS
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
New styles are here, and it is time to start making a fashion trend! Create some memories with the CUTE ICONS!

+ Includes 1 free skin

items.title: Epic Emo Anime Teens
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
They march among us, and they walk with style.
It is not a day-to-day community, and being a part of it is no easy task.
Pick up a mask and join us and get one of the coolest skins ever!

+ 12 epic skins in total!

items.title: Classy & Rich
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Get ready to be the classiest and richest player in the game! You don't need to think about your clothes, we have prepared a great pack for you! Pick your favorite skin now and start dazzling others!

+ 14 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Patriotic Teens
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Everyone is celebrating! Wherever you are, enjoy and join this amazing party where you can wear a variety of colorful skins to dance and show off your skills!

-10 skins!
-1 skin totally free!
-Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Phantoms
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Scare your friends, lurk in the shadows and time your moment just right for the ultimate jump scare! All you need now is a big castle to haunt!

- 8 skins!
- Ghosts, phantoms, skeletons! Pick which skin suits you best!

items.title: Stylish Masks
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
The mysterious masked teens are looking for new recruits to join their exclusive club! Quick, grab your favourite mask and become a living legend in the night city of your favourite minecraft server! No matter your preference, be it formal and elegant or colorful and cute, there is a masked skin for everyone!

- 12 skins
- by inPixel

items.title: Spooky Style
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
This patch of teens has been waiting all year to carve a great time for Halloween!

*1 Free Skin

items.title: Halloween Party
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Halloween has arrived, and it's time to party. With these skins you have many costumes to show off and will be the coolest at the party.

-10 skins!
-1 skin totally free!
-Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Alien Teens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Enjoy your teen years as an extraterrestrial in the vastness of space! Get yourself some cool and epic alien looks for your adventures in a galaxy far, far away! 

- 12 Alien skins
- By Geniely

items.title: Neon Dropper Teens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Free-falling through endless tubes full of obstacles and never ending action. This skinpack contains 12 epic skins which are perfect for becoming a pro in the minigame "Dropper". Challenge your flying skills and jump! Become the winner of every dropper gaming session with your friends!

- 12 skins 
- By RareLoot

items.title: Winter Carol
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Sing a song in front of your fireplace! Gather round, sing a winter carol, read fairy tales, and cuddle with your friends and family!

- 8 unique skins!
- 1 FREE skin!
- Includes warm clothing even in the coldest snow!

items.title: Simple Spawns Holiday Hideout
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Take some vacations to a chilly holiday hideout! The accommodations for visitors are warm log cabins with a cheerful holiday charm. Pick out a cabin and enjoy your time off.

- A log cabin getaway in a snowy wonderland.
- Adventures to be had around town.
- Enjoy the snow with your best friends.

items.title: Anime Legends IV
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The all-time favourite anime skin pack returns once again. With even more legendary anime characters skins being added you can become the ultimate collector!

- 15 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: SCP Prison 2
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
More horror awaits those who dare to enter the haunted and derelict prison! Will you conquer your fear or will SCP Prison 2 turn out to be too much for you to handle? Test your courage once again!

- Prison survival spawn
- By RareLoot
